shortDescription: Thailand's central bank supports proposals for a tax on gold trading, the governor said on Thursday.A gold tax of 0.01% would not hurt the industry, Vitai Ratanakorn said.The central bank also plans more measures to curb illicit funds, he said.

children: Thailand's central bank supports proposals for a tax on gold trading, the governor said on Thursday.
A gold tax of 0.01% would not hurt the industry, Vitai Ratanakorn said.
The central bank also plans more measures to curb illicit funds, he said.
